skill.name: obsidian-markdown
skill.description: Create and edit Obsidian-flavored Markdown with wikilinks, embeds, callouts, properties, tags, tables, math, and Mermaid examples.
skill.summary: Draft and revise Obsidian Markdown notes with wikilinks, embeds, callouts, properties, tags, tables, math, and diagrams.
skill.author: ZhanlinCui

security_audit.summary: All static findings are false positives in a documentation-only SKILL.md file. Backtick detections are Markdown fences or inline syntax examples, URL detections are reference or example links, and blocker detections are ordinary prose, block IDs, or Mermaid examples. No prompt injection, data exfiltration, executable scripts, or external command instructions were found.

content.value_statement: Obsidian users need notes that follow vault-friendly Markdown conventions. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code produce clean notes with Obsidian syntax.
actual_capabilities: Creates wikilinks, aliases, heading links, and block links for Obsidian notes.
Formats note embeds, image embeds, audio embeds, PDF embeds, and search embeds.
Adds Obsidian callouts, foldable callouts, nested callouts, and supported callout types.
Structures YAML-style properties, tags, aliases, status fields, dates, and checkboxes.
Explains tables, math, Mermaid diagrams, footnotes, comments, and HTML inside notes.
limitations: It does not run Obsidian or verify links against a live vault.
It cannot install plugins or change Obsidian application settings.
It depends on user-provided vault names, file names, and note conventions.
It provides formatting guidance, not storage, sync, or publishing automation.

use_cases.title: Organize Research Notes
use_cases.description: Create connected notes with citations, wikilinks, tags, and callouts for recurring research themes.

use_cases.title: Build Project Knowledge Bases
use_cases.description: Turn project plans into structured Obsidian notes with tasks, properties, embeds, and related documents.

use_cases.title: Prepare Study Vaults
use_cases.description: Draft study notes with headings, definitions, examples, task lists, and review-friendly callouts.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Obsidian note about [topic]. Use a title, short sections, tags, and relevant wikilinks.

prompt_templates.title: Add Callouts and Tasks
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this note for Obsidian. Add useful callouts, task lists, tags, and links to related notes.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Existing Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert the pasted content into Obsidian-flavored Markdown. Preserve meaning, add properties, and use wikilinks for key concepts.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Connected Vault Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an advanced Obsidian project note for [project]. Include properties, embeds, callouts, tasks, footnotes, diagram guidance, and related links.

output_examples.input: A request for a project planning note in Obsidian.
output_examples.output: A structured project note with properties, overview sections, tasks, callouts, and related note links.

output_examples.input: A draft article with plain Markdown links.
output_examples.output: An Obsidian-ready note that replaces key references with wikilinks and adds clean tags.

output_examples.input: A study topic that needs review material.
output_examples.output: A study note with headings, definitions, examples, task lists, and callouts for key ideas.

best_practices: Ask for vault naming rules before creating wikilinks or aliases.
Use properties for metadata that should stay consistent across notes.
Keep embeds and callouts purposeful so notes remain readable.
anti_patterns: Do not create wikilinks for every common word.
Do not mix inconsistent tag styles in the same vault.
Do not add unsupported Obsidian syntax when plain Markdown is clearer.

faq.question: Does this skill run Obsidian or install plugins?
faq.answer: No. It helps format Markdown content for Obsidian-compatible notes.

faq.question: Can it create wikilinks and embeds?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft wikilinks, note embeds, image embeds, and links to headings or blocks.

faq.question: Can it edit existing notes?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the note text and explain the desired changes.

faq.question: Does it validate every vault-specific link?
faq.answer: No. It can format links, but it cannot know all vault files unless you provide them.

faq.question: Can it help with properties and tags?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create properties, tag lists, aliases, and status fields.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
